data.title: bn-1ojm v4 admission decision
data.description: ADR 0003: DECLINE the v4 commit-capsule format as a product. Deliverables: docs/adr/0003-v4-admission.md (normative decision record), a surgical resolved-by pointer in ADR 0002 section 4, reconciliation of docs/spec/01-log-format.md and 04-registry.md so neither presents v4 as pending, and demotion notes on the retained v4 module. RECOMMENDATION PENDING LEAD RATIFICATION - do not merge without mess-dev sign-off. Key evidence: empty constituency (snapshot install declined by ADR 0002, projection checkpoints by bn-11mk, dedupe by bn-2ctq); measured gap density 49.27 percent demo and 49.82 percent large in social corpora but harmless on the read path; v4 framing is plus 40 bytes per frame so it only shrinks logs below about 2.7 appends per stream; the spike scan gate is per-byte and cancels that size increase.
